transcript.text: Hi, I'm Sensei. Put your page under the camera and start solving. I'm watching.
You multiplied speed by time, but the units don't match—what unit is the speed in, and what unit should it be for this calculation?
Oh the speed is in kilometers per hour but time is seconds. So I need meters per second?
Yes, you need to convert km/h to m/s. What's 72 km/h in m/s?
Um I think you divide by 3.6, so 20 meters per second. Then 20 times 5 is 100 meters.
Yes, 72 km/h is 20 m/s, and 20 times 5 is 100 meters. Write that down and keep going.
Okay but why is it 3.6 though? My teacher just said divide by 3.6.
Because 1 kilometer is 1000 meters and 1 hour is 3600 seconds, so 72 km/h is 72 times 1000 meters per 3600 seconds.
Oh so 3600 over 1000 is 3.6. So 72 times 1000 over 3600 is 20, then 20 times 5 is 100 meters. Got it, thanks.
Got it. Give me a second.
Yes, you're right—3600 divided by 1000 is 3.6, so 72 times 1000 over 3600 gives 20 m/s. Great job!
